reviewNotes: Twenty-five bedroom, kitchen, family-letter, and clinic-bedroom map strings were translated directly from English. Two full editorial audits cover inspection context, fashion and medical titles, canonical nations and islands, character details, line-break controls, humor, and natural Romanian; both found no remaining objective issue.

HaleyHouse.6.source: There's a little note on the pot. 'Something to remember me by. -Sandy'
